description: This Java source file defines the class 'ConceptNumeric', a subclass of 'Concept', within the OpenMRS project. The class extends the concept model by adding numeric-specific properties such as range limits, units, display precision, and reference ranges, representing a specialized concept used for numeric data within the medical record system.

classes.name: ConceptNumeric
classes.description: A class representing numeric concepts within the OpenMRS system, extending the base 'Concept' class by adding properties for numeric ranges, units, display precision, reference ranges, and allowing decimals, used for representing quantitative data in medical records.
